config_diagnostics.description: Enable diagnostic output; set to 1 to make config errors fatal, 0 to ignore them.

engine_ctrls.description: Map of engine names to additional ctrl commands and values.

engine_default_algs.description: Map of engine names to default_algorithms strings (e.g., 'ALL').

engine_ids.description: Map of engine names to custom engine_id overrides.

engine_inits.description: Map of engine names to init flags (0 or 1).

engine_paths.description: Map of engine names to dynamic_path values (shared library paths).

engines_config.description: Map of engine names to config section names.

env_defaults.description: Map of environment variable names to default values for fallbacks.

extra_ssl_opts.description: Map of section names to extra SSL_CONF_cmd directives.

includes.description: List of file/directory paths to include via .include directives.

min_proto_dtls.description: Minimum DTLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

min_proto_tls.description: Minimum TLS protocol version (e.g., '1.2') for system_default.

oid_section.description: Name of section containing custom OIDs (e.g., 'oids').

oids.description: Map of OID short names to 'long_name, 1.2.3.4' values.

openssl_conf.description: Name of the initialization section containing module selectors.

provider_activated.description: Map of provider names to activation flags (values are ignored, presence activates).

provider_extra.description: Map of provider names to additional key-value config pairs.

provider_identities.description: Map of provider names to custom identity overrides.

provider_modules.description: Map of provider names to shared library paths.

providers_config.description: Map of provider names (e.g., 'default') to their section names (e.g., 'default_provider').

rng_properties.description: Property query string for RNG and underlying algorithms.

rng_seed_properties.description: Property query for the randomness source.

rng_type.description: Random bit generator type: CTR-DRBG, HASH-DRBG, or HMAC-DRBG.

server_certs.description: Map of certificate types (e.g., 'RSA', 'ECDSA') to cert file paths (for server config).

ssl_configs.description: Map of SSL config names (e.g., 'system_default', 'server') to section names.
